arguments.question: Evaluate macro drivers of ANET over 5, 21, and 63 completed sessions. Use dated Fed/rate evidence and SPY, XLK, IWM, and HYG observations to distinguish the competing channels of discount-rate/multiple pressure versus resilient hyperscaler and enterprise networking orders. Identify whether current cross-asset behavior is risk-on or risk-off only to the extent supported, avoid inventing company sensitivity, and provide observable macro conditions that would strengthen or weaken the ANET case. Stop after the registered rate/market sources unless one primary macro document is clearly necessary; report unavailable quantified beta or order sensitivity as a gap.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether macro conditions reinforce or offset the company case and how much weight to place on valuation compression risk over the requested weeks-to-months horizon.
